description: Audiomark AI validation set. Ground-truth labels for detection accuracy measurement. Paths resolve against the named roots; override any root with AUDIOMARK_EVAL_ROOT_<NAME> or --root name=path.

label_definitions.ai: Fully generated by a generative audio model.
label_definitions.human: Created by human performance/production with no generative AI in the signal chain.
label_definitions.ai_assisted: Human-produced but with some generative AI contribution (a rendered stem, a partial pass). A distinct statutory question from 'ai' and scored separately.

expected_provenance_definitions.c2pa_signed: Carries a signed C2PA/Content Credentials manifest.
expected_provenance_definitions.watermark_only: Carries an inaudible watermark but no manifest (e.g. SynthID with metadata stripped).
expected_provenance_definitions.none: Carries no provenance payload of any kind.
